recommended.title: BetaFPV 95X V3 Over Water — SMO 4K Settings & Flight Time
recommended.description:
This was my second day with the BetaFPV 95X V3 and Insta360 SMO 4K: a New Year's Day cinematic flight over water after another pilot's video inspired me to show the little cinewhoop to my dad.

The settings I saved in my replies: ISO locked at 100, the remaining camera settings on auto, Log capture, and color correction in DaVinci Resolve. I used a 450mAh 4S pack and estimated roughly 2.5-3 minutes in the windy conditions that day.

This is real field footage, not a controlled review, range test, waterproofing demonstration, or recommendation to copy the route. The old record does not preserve the complete aircraft build, full camera and stabilization settings, raw-file metadata, voltage log, exact wind, route, or every export choice.

Watch next — my later Insta360 Ace Pro FPV sunset test:
https://youtu.be/OFeCTH2LP9s

Full flight notes, evidence limits, and a safer retest checklist:
https://colinmichaels.com/blog/betafpv-95x-v3-over-water-flight-notes?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=betafpv_95x_archive_gateway&utm_content=ijjzir1qm1y_article

Download the Captain Colin Drone Flight Field Notes:
https://colinmichaels.com/downloads/captain-colin-drone-flight-field-notes.pdf?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=betafpv_95x_archive_gateway&utm_content=ijjzir1qm1y_field_notes

More Captain Colin flights and field notes:
https://colinmichaels.com/topics/drones-fpv?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=betafpv_95x_archive_gateway&utm_content=ijjzir1qm1y_drones

Current U.S. recreational drone guidance:
https://www.faa.gov/uas/recreational_flyers

The model, firmware, rules, and my own standards have moved on since 2021. Recheck the exact aircraft, current official documentation, airspace, and applicable rules before any new flight.
